candidateDecisions.label: Data and information management with analytics

analysis: The first option integrates Python, SQL, data science and algorithms with accounting, product design, organizational behavior and digital strategy. Market inquiry, quantitative and qualitative methods and responsible technology support informed adoption. Accounting & Corporate Finance adds direct costing, budgeting and performance overlap, improving the organizational option more than a second general methods course. The second option shifts to a sustained quantitative spine with linear algebra, probability, numerical computation, linear systems, machine learning and neural networks. Research Methods & Statistics and experimental methods provide empirical grounding. The third option builds software, networks, operating systems and algorithms on programming, logic and mathematics and retains databases and technology ethics; its systems depth serves the documented programming and technology learning line. Database Management Systems substantively supports design, querying and authorization based on its description. Other description-only courses support strategy, user inquiry and reinforcement learning on their stated content. Privacy and social consequences are addressed through AI ethics and governance; OU offers more dedicated information security. Enterprise modeling, ontology, specialist project management and a required 15 EC project remain distinct gaps. UCR independent research is outside the scheduled 180 EC. The three options exceed the 30 EC difference floor and have separate substantive aims.
